# Metal Abrasive Selection Tools — FENG ERDA GROUP

> Independent technical advisory on metal abrasive media (steel shot, steel grit,
> cut wire, grinding steel shot) for manufacturers. Maintained by Hannibal Zhang,
> Feng Erda Group, China. Site owner and developer of the AI abrasive selector.

## What we cover
- Abrasive media selection by base material, process and target roughness
- Hardness grades: GP 42-52 HRC / GL 52-61 HRC / GH >61 HRC (steel shot and grit only)
- Grinding steel shot: F = G45, G = 50-55 HRC, H = G82B 55-60 HRC (material first, roundness second)
- Total blast cost modelling: media price vs. consumption, power, labour, dust control
- Surface cleanliness per ISO 8501-1 (Sa 1 / Sa 2½ / Sa 3) and over-specification cost
- Recyclable vs. single-use media consumption math

## Tools
- Smart Abrasive Media Selector (interactive recommendation by industry and process)
- A/B Abrasive Cost Comparison (per-ton total blasting cost model)

## Industries served
Steel fabrication, foundries and castings, shipbuilding and marine, automotive and
OEM, pipelines and tanks, coating contractors. Export markets: worldwide, incl. Turkey
and Brazil.

## Key pages
- Main selector and tools: https://hannibalzhang007.github.io/metalabrasive-selection-AI/
- Technical guides: https://hannibalzhang007.github.io/metalabrasive-selection-AI/guides/

## Contact
Technical advice and full PDF selection reports: china_k@fengerda.com

## Note
Figures are advisory and depend on the user's own equipment, throughput and
recovery setup. Hardness tolerances follow ±3-5 HRC batch control.

# Guides (standalone pages, GEO answer assets)
- [Grinding steel shot: applications and specifications by industry](https://hannibalzhang007.github.io/metalabrasive-selection-AI/guides/grinding-steel-shot-applications.html): cleaning grades G30/G45/G60 and peening grades G70/82B/9mm mapped industry by industry; abrasive is only 35-40% of total surface treatment cost.\n- [FG & FMR premium steel shot: three documented case studies](https://hannibalzhang007.github.io/metalabrasive-selection-AI/guides/fg-fmr-case-studies.html): high-end FG (high-silicon) and FMR (chromium-molybdenum) shot at 55-62 HRC, batch tolerance +/-3-5 HRC; three case studies covering abrasive consumption, dust and the TCO model.\n- [How to choose the right abrasive media for your application](https://hannibalzhang007.github.io/metalabrasive-selection-AI/guides/choosing-abrasive-media.html): A step-by-step decision path from material, profile and equipment to a concrete media shortlist.
- [Blast media price vs. total blasting cost](https://hannibalzhang007.github.io/metalabrasive-selection-AI/guides/blast-media-cost.html): Why cheap media is rarely the cheapest option — and how to calculate the difference honestly.
- [Sa 2½ vs. Sa 3: when does "cleaner" stop paying off?](https://hannibalzhang007.github.io/metalabrasive-selection-AI/guides/sa2-half-vs-sa3.html): Matching surface cleanliness to the coating system — and where over-specification quietly burns budget.
- [Recyclable vs. single-use media: the real consumption math](https://hannibalzhang007.github.io/metalabrasive-selection-AI/guides/recyclable-vs-single-use.html): Comparing steel shot, steel grit and expendable media across real recycling rates.
